source:
Have you often wondered at the true form and character of your lover? Pay careful mind: here are eight signs he's foe rather than friend! 

FIRST, within mere days of your acquaintance, he declares that if you 'call him but love, he'll be new baptis'd.' This nobleman is a walking source of dramatic show, clinging to any poor girl who crosses his path. Abnormally likely to meet his end in poison and tears.

SECOND, he uses the term 'taming' or 'shrew' in your presence—or even worse, in the same sentence. If he attempts to starve you to break your will, eat his heart out.

THIRD, he suddenly finds himself madly in love with your closest friend after promising you his undying heart. Keep a sharp eye out for faerie dust in the vicinity. 

FOURTH, he sticks a dagger in your back, then blames it on your 'ambition.' Don't worry: your restless spirit will have revenge. Stay indoors on March 15 if possible.

FIVE, after you help him murder his friends and cover up the crimes, he begins embarrassing you with inappropriate sobbing at your dinner parties. Even the most heartening prophecy can't revive this relationship. 

SIX, he tells you your wife has been unfaithful, but offers flimsy proof. Take a walk, enjoy some deep breathing, and stay away from pillows.

SEVEN, he tries to convince you to kill your brother. One might think this clear as day, yet this author is continually surprised.

EIGHT, sometimes he tells you to get to a nunnery. Other times he tells you he 'did love you once.' Which is it? Send this uncouth boy sulking back to university!
target:
你是否常常琢磨，恋人的真面目和品性究竟如何？请留个心眼：下面八个征兆，说明他是敌人，而非朋友！ 

第一，才认识几天，他就宣称，只要你“叫他一声爱人，他便重新受洗”。这位贵族浑身都是戏，见到哪个可怜姑娘都要纠缠一番。他死于毒药与泪水的可能性高得离谱。

第二，他当着你的面说起“驯服”或“悍妇”——更糟的是，把这两个词用在同一句话里。他若想靠饿着你来磨掉你的意志，那就把他的心挖出来吃掉。

第三，刚向你许下永不变心的誓言，他就突然疯狂地爱上了你最亲密的朋友。留意一下附近有没有仙子的魔法粉。 

第四，他在你背后捅了一刀，却说都是你的“野心”惹的祸。别担心：你不得安息的亡魂自会报仇。三月十五日，能不出门就别出门。

第五，你帮他杀害朋友、掩盖罪行之后，他却在你的晚宴上哭哭啼啼，失态得让你难堪。再鼓舞人心的预言，也救不了这段关系。 

第六，他说你的妻子对你不忠，却拿不出像样的证据。出去散散步，做几个深呼吸，别碰枕头。

第七，他试图说服你杀死自己的兄弟。这迹象似乎再明显不过了，可笔者仍一再为此感到惊讶。

第八，他一会儿叫你进修道院，一会儿又说他“曾经确实爱过你”。到底哪句才算数？把这个没教养的小子赶回大学，让他自己生闷气去！

source:
...And so it came to pass that the King of the Realm died one night, leaving his two sons behind. In this savage and warlike country, it was customary that whichever child inherited the crown for himself would immediately kill the others, eliminating further competition. However, these two brothers were twins, born within a scant few moments of one another. And so they brought the matter to High Executioner Selene.

They found her standing at the edge of the highest cliff in the kingdom, above the rolling and raging sea. 

"I am twenty seconds older than my brother," said the first prince. "Without any doubt at all, I am the rightful heir. Lady Selene, please cast my brother over this cliff immediately!" 

Lady Selene bound the second prince's hands and led him to the edge of the cliff. But the second prince sputtered, suddenly, "This is wrong! I may be younger, but my brother's body is weak and frail. He becomes sicker each day, and soon he may very well die. Then the Kingdom will be left with no heir at all! Don't kill me—kill him!"

Lady Selene paused to think a moment, then bound the first prince's hands, too.

The first prince spat with disgust. "My brother is a jealous imbecile!" Lady Selene wrapped a blindfold around his eyes.

The second prince stamped his foot. "My brother is a weakling and cannot see reason!" As with the first prince, the second prince, too, was soon blindfolded. Both of them continued to argue at the top of their lungs, screaming for the other one's demise.

Then the sound of Executioner Selene's fading footsteps caught their attention. "High Executioner, come back! You must kill my brother! I must be king! Where are you going?"

"I'm off to pour myself a flagon of wine and then pursue a career change to the next kingdom over, in that order," Selene replied. "Sounds like this one's gone a bit rotten. Good luck finding your way home with those blindfolds and binds on, lads."

The two men lunged at each other, unwilling to stand down. And the both of them went tipping over the edge, careening into the sea. The kingdom was none the worse for it, in the end.
target:
……于是，一天夜里，这个王国的国王去世了，留下两个儿子。在这个野蛮好战的国家，按惯例，无论哪个孩子继承王位，都会立即杀死其他孩子，铲除日后的竞争者。然而，这两兄弟是双胞胎，出生只相隔短短片刻。因此，他们把这件事交给了首席刽子手塞勒涅。

他们找到她时，她正站在王国最高的悬崖边，下方是翻腾咆哮的大海。 

“我比弟弟早出生二十秒，”第一位王子说，“毫无疑问，我才是合法的继承人。塞勒涅女士，请立刻把我弟弟扔下悬崖！” 

塞勒涅女士绑住第二位王子的双手，把他带到悬崖边。可第二位王子突然结结巴巴地喊道：“这不对！我或许年纪小些，但我哥哥身体虚弱，弱不禁风。他一天比一天病得重，很可能不久就会死。到时，王国就一个继承人也没有了！别杀我——杀他！”

塞勒涅女士停下来想了一会儿，然后把第一位王子的双手也绑了起来。

第一位王子厌恶地啐了一口。“我弟弟就是个嫉妒成性的蠢货！”塞勒涅女士用布蒙住了他的眼睛。

第二位王子跺着脚。“我哥哥是个病秧子，根本不讲道理！”和第一位王子一样，第二位王子很快也被蒙住了眼睛。两人仍扯着嗓子争吵，尖叫着要对方去死。

这时，刽子手塞勒涅渐渐远去的脚步声引起了他们的注意。“首席刽子手，回来！你必须杀了我兄弟！我必须当国王！你要去哪儿？”

“我先去给自己斟上一壶酒，再到隔壁王国改行。就按这个顺序来。”塞勒涅答道，“看来这个王国已经有些腐朽了。小伙子们，你们蒙着眼、捆着手，祝你们还能找到回家的路。”

两个男人谁也不肯退让，猛地扑向对方。结果两人一起跌出了崖边，直坠大海。到头来，王国也没因此变得更糟。
